evidence.statement: The v0.0.14 unbiased sample contains MOP tokens in tRNA, rRNA, other ncRNA, repeat/mobile, mitochondrial, CDS and intergenic contexts.

LIFE-CODE should preserve a layered architecture-specification lens in addition to a flat symbol dictionary: decoder/interface, execution core, firmware/control, mobile code, integrated subsystem, executable code and distributed runtime relationships may require different sequence representations.
An OS-like biological layer, if useful, should emerge from relationships and compatibility interfaces among components rather than being assigned to one annotation class.
FOUNDATION_RUNTIME contains 18 sampled MOP occurrences against a genome-matched valid-16nt expectation of 26.912.
INTEGRATION_STACK contains 42 sampled MOP occurrences against expectation 37.545.
Normalized ratios are FOUNDATION_RUNTIME 0.6689x, INTEGRATION_STACK 1.1186x, and HOST_EXECUTABLE 0.8812x.
Architecture-layer interpretation must follow the frozen prediction outcomes rather than the raw 2/5/11/14/24 count ordering; individual component diagnostics may differ sharply within a composite.

unknowns: Conserved system-role identity of cross-genome MOP tokens.
